newsitem.title: USA: Vectra to acquire two-branch bank.
newsitem.headline: Vectra to acquire two-branch bank.

text.p: Vectra Banking Corp said Tuesday it has signed an agreement to acquire Professional Bank, a two-branch bank based in Denver.

Under the terms of the agreement, Vectra will purchase all of the stock of Professional Bank, an operating asset of the bankruptcy estate of Oren Benton, which is being liquidated. The transaction subject to approval by the bankruptcy court and banking regulators.
The proposed transaction is for cash and will be reported using purchase accounting, Vectra Chief Financial Officer Ray Nash said in a statement.
Nash said the acquisition "will be modestly accretive to Vectra's earnings this year."
Vectra an independent Colorado-based bank holding company.
